name: Flockfly
summary: A black-and-white group travel desk with flight search, seat maps and split costs
about: Flockfly plans a made-up group trip for fourteen friends, in black and white with one orange highlight. Search flights once for everyone, watch the route animate, then seat the whole group on a seat map. It also handles travellers, a drag-and-drop day plan, bookings, shared costs with a settle-up list and a documents checklist.
how: Watch the countdown to departure tick on the Trip page
Search flights, sort by best, cheapest or fastest, and filter by stops and price
Pick a flight, then seat everyone: choose a traveller and a seat, or drag a name onto a seat
Drag an activity to another day on the day plan
Add a shared expense and see the fewest payments that square everyone up
Tick off passports, visas and insurance for each traveller
